snippet.title: Edge of Memories | Demo Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to experience the first chapter of Edge of Memories!

We're bringing a free demo to Steam on June 15th. Our main heroine Eline meets Ysoris, a returning member from Edge of Eternity. Find out what brought these two together and how their unlikely partnership might change the fate of this doomed planet. 

Edge of Memories will be coming to PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series.
